en: which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen.
Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.
They will not hear therein any ill speech -
They will not hear therein any ill speech -
and they will have their provision therein,

ar: ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
en: which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
